#######################################
# Required CMake version              #
#######################################
cmake_minimum_required( VERSION 3.18 )

#######################################
# Project name                        #
#######################################
project( OpENer LANGUAGES C VERSION 2.3 )

#######################################
# Project version                     #
#######################################

if( NOT DEFINED OpENer_Device_Config_Vendor_Id )
  set( OpENer_Device_Config_Vendor_Id 1 CACHE STRING "Device Vendor ID" )
endif()
if( NOT DEFINED OpENer_Device_Config_Device_Type )
  set( OpENer_Device_Config_Device_Type 12 CACHE STRING "Device Type ID" )
endif()
if( NOT DEFINED OpENer_Device_Config_Product_Code )
  set( OpENer_Device_Config_Product_Code 65001 CACHE STRING "Device Product Code" )
endif()
if( NOT DEFINED OpENer_Device_Config_Device_Name )
  set( OpENer_Device_Config_Device_Name "OpENer Device" CACHE STRING "Device Name" )
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED OpENer_Device_Major_Version)
  set(OpENer_Device_Major_Version ${PROJECT_VERSION_MAJOR} CACHE STRING "Major Version")
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED OpENer_Device_Minor_Version)
  set(OpENer_Device_Minor_Version ${PROJECT_VERSION_MINOR} CACHE STRING "Minor Version")
endif()

configure_file(  
	"${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ports/devicedata.h.in"
	"${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/src/ports/devicedata.h"
	)

set(OpENer_BUILDSUPPORT_DIR "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/buildsupport")
if(NOT EXISTS "${OpENer_BUILDSUPPORT_DIR}/OpENer.cmake")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "OpENer build support not found at ${OpENer_BUILDSUPPORT_DIR}")
endif()

INCLUDE( ${OpENer_BUILDSUPPORT_DIR}/OpENer.cmake )

option(OPENER_RANDOMIZE_CONNECTION_ID "Use randomized connection IDs also for lower 16-bits?" FALSE)
option(OPENER_PRODUCED_DATA_HAS_RUN_IDLE_HEADER "Shall produced data from OpENer also include a run idle header?" FALSE)
option(OPENER_CONSUMED_DATA_HAS_RUN_IDLE_HEADER "Will consumed data from OpENer also include a run idle header?" TRUE)
option(OPENER_MICRO800_RUN_IDLE_COMPAT "Rockwell Micro800/Logix run-idle header workarounds (see doc/features/MICRO800_RUN_IDLE_COMPAT.md)" ON)
option(OPENER_LLDP "Build OpENer with LLDP CIP object support" FALSE)
option(OPENER_NB_LLDP "NetBurner wire LLDP (requires netburner backend)" FALSE)
option(OPENER_NB_ACD "NetBurner ACD wire module (requires netburner backend)" FALSE)
option(CIP_SECURITY_OBJECTS "Build OpENer with CIP Security object family support" FALSE)
option(OPENER_INSTALL_AS_LIB "Build and install OpENer as a library" FALSE)
option(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS "Build OpENer as shared library" FALSE)

if(OPENER_RANDOMIZE_CONNECTION_ID)
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_RANDOMIZE_CONNECTION_ID)
endif()

if(OPENER_PRODUCED_DATA_HAS_RUN_IDLE_HEADER)
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_PRODUCED_DATA_HAS_RUN_IDLE_HEADER)
endif()

if(OPENER_CONSUMED_DATA_HAS_RUN_IDLE_HEADER)
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_CONSUMED_DATA_HAS_RUN_IDLE_HEADER)
endif()

if(OPENER_MICRO800_RUN_IDLE_COMPAT)
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_MICRO800_RUN_IDLE_COMPAT=1)
endif()

if(OPENER_LLDP)
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_LLDP)
endif()

if(OPENER_NB_LLDP)
  if(NOT OPENER_LLDP)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "OPENER_NB_LLDP requires OPENER_LLDP=ON")
  endif()
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_NB_LLDP=1)
  add_definitions(-DALLOW_CUSTOM_NET_DO_RX=1)
endif()

if(OPENER_NB_ACD)
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_NB_ACD=1)
endif()

set(OPENER_BUILD_PROFILE "none" CACHE STRING "Library build tier: none, core, extended")
if(OPENER_BUILD_PROFILE STREQUAL "extended")
  if(NOT OPENER_LLDP)
    message(WARNING "OPENER_BUILD_PROFILE=extended requires OPENER_LLDP=ON for LLDP CIP objects")
  endif()
elseif(NOT OPENER_BUILD_PROFILE STREQUAL "none")
  if(NOT OPENER_BUILD_PROFILE STREQUAL "core")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unknown OPENER_BUILD_PROFILE: ${OPENER_BUILD_PROFILE} (use none, core, or extended)")
  endif()
endif()

if(CIP_SECURITY_OBJECTS)
  add_definitions(-DCIP_SECURITY_OBJECTS=1)
endif()

option(OPENER_IS_DLR_DEVICE "Is OpENer built with support for a basic DLR device?" FALSE)
if (OPENER_IS_DLR_DEVICE)
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_IS_DLR_DEVICE)
endif()

# This buffer size will be used for any received message.
# The same buffer is used for the replied explicit message.
# There are two uses in OpENer:
#   1. Explicit messages will use this buffer to store the data generated by the request
#   2. I/O Connections will use this buffer for the produced data
set( OPENER_ETHERNET_BUFFER_SIZE "512" CACHE STRING "Number of bytes used for the Ethernet message buffer")
add_definitions(-DPC_OPENER_ETHERNET_BUFFER_SIZE=${OPENER_ETHERNET_BUFFER_SIZE} )

set(OPENER_NET_BACKEND "netburner" CACHE STRING "Network HAL: netburner (production) or stub (dev-only)")
if(NOT OPENER_NNDK_ARCH)
  set(OPENER_NNDK_ARCH "cortex-m7" CACHE STRING "NetBurner arch folder under OPENER_NNDK_ROOT/arch/")
endif()
if(NOT OPENER_NNDK_CPU)
  set(OPENER_NNDK_CPU "SAME70" CACHE STRING "NetBurner CPU folder under arch/<arch>/cpu/ (e.g. SAME70, MIMXRT10xx)")
endif()
if(NOT OPENER_NNDK_PLATFORM)
  set(OPENER_NNDK_PLATFORM "MODM7AE70" CACHE STRING "NetBurner platform folder under platform/ (e.g. MODM7AE70, MOD5441X)")
endif()

option(OPENER_BUILD_NETWORK_LAYER "Build network handler layer (requires a network HAL backend)" ON)
option(OPENER_BUILD_NVDATA "Build POSIX file-based NV storage (skip for NB firmware bring-up)" OFF)
option(OPENER_ALLOW_HOST_NETBURNER_BUILD "Allow NetBurner backend with host compiler (dev header check only)" OFF)

if(OPENER_NET_BACKEND STREQUAL "stub")
  if(OPENER_BUILD_NETWORK_LAYER)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
      "OPENER_NET_BACKEND=stub is dev-only. Set OPENER_BUILD_NETWORK_LAYER=OFF, "
      "or use OPENER_NET_BACKEND=netburner for product builds.")
  endif()
elseif(OPENER_NET_BACKEND STREQUAL "netburner")
  if(NOT OPENER_BUILD_NETWORK_LAYER)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
      "OPENER_NET_BACKEND=netburner requires OPENER_BUILD_NETWORK_LAYER=ON.")
  endif()
  # NetBurner examples rely on TCP/IP interface attributes (incl. Host Name)
  # being settable via SetAttributeSingle.
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_TCPIP_IFACE_CFG_SETTABLE=1)
  # Show Ethernet Link interface label on Class 0xF6 attribute 10.
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_ETHLINK_LABEL_ENABLE=1)
  # Expose Ethernet Link interface/media counter attributes 4 and 5.
  add_definitions(-DOPENER_ETHLINK_CNTRS_ENABLE=1)
  if(NOT OPENER_NNDK_ROOT)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "OPENER_NNDK_ROOT must point to the NetBurner SDK (e.g. C:/nburn)")
  endif()
  if(NOT EXISTS "${OPENER_NNDK_ROOT}/nbrtos/include")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
      "OPENER_NNDK_ROOT does not contain nbrtos/include: ${OPENER_NNDK_ROOT}")
  endif()
  if(NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING AND NOT OPENER_ALLOW_HOST_NETBURNER_BUILD)
    message(WARNING
      "NetBurner backend with host compiler produces .lib files not usable in "
      "NBEclipse firmware. Pass -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=.../Toolchain-NetBurner-NNDK.cmake "
      "or set OPENER_ALLOW_HOST_NETBURNER_BUILD=ON to suppress this warning.")
  endif()
else()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unknown OPENER_NET_BACKEND: \"${OPENER_NET_BACKEND}\". Use netburner or stub.")
endif()

set( OPENER_HAL_MEM_POOL_SIZE "32768" CACHE STRING "Static memory pool size in bytes for CipCalloc")
add_definitions(-DOPENER_HAL_MEM_POOL_SIZE=${OPENER_HAL_MEM_POOL_SIZE})

if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
  set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib" CACHE PATH "Static library output")
  set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/lib")
endif()

#######################################
# Platform-dependent functions check  #
#######################################
INCLUDE( ${OpENer_BUILDSUPPORT_DIR}/OpENer_function_checks.cmake )

#######################################
# OpENer tracer switches              #
#######################################
set( OpENer_TRACES OFF CACHE BOOL "Activate OpENer traces" )
if(OpENer_TRACES)
  createTraceLevelOptions()
endif(OpENer_TRACES)

#######################################
# OpENer documentation target "doc"   #
#######################################

option(OPENER_BUILD_DOCS "Build OpENer Doxygen documentation" OFF)
if(OPENER_BUILD_DOCS)
  # check if Doxygen is installed
  find_package(Doxygen REQUIRED)
    # set input and output files
    set(DOXYGEN_IN ${OpENer_SOURCE_DIR}/opener.doxyfile.in)
    set(DOXYGEN_OUT ${OpENer_BINARY_DIR}/opener.doxyfile)

    set(OpENer_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS " */src/hal/opener_hal_stub.c")

    # request to configure the file
    configure_file(${DOXYGEN_IN} ${DOXYGEN_OUT} @ONLY)

    # note the option ALL which will build the docs always with the default target
    add_custom_target( doc # ALL
        COMMAND ${DOXYGEN_EXECUTABLE} ${DOXYGEN_OUT}
        WORKING_DIRECTORY ${OpENer_SOURCE_DIR}
        COMMENT "Generating API documentation with Doxygen"
        VERBATIM )
    message("-- Doxygen setup done")
endif()


#######################################
# OpENer C flags                      #
#######################################
if(MSVC)
  set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} /W4")
else()
  set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS} -Wall -Wconversion")
endif()

####################################################
# Internal cache holding the available CIP objects #
####################################################

# Add definitions for additional CIP Objects
string(COMPARE NOTEQUAL "${OpENer_ADD_CIP_OBJECTS}" "" OpENer_HAS_ADDITIONAL_OBJECT)
if (OpENer_HAS_ADDITIONAL_OBJECT)
    string(REPLACE " " ";" OpENer_ADD_CIP_OBJECTS_LIST ${OpENer_ADD_CIP_OBJECTS})
    foreach (CIP_OBJECT IN LISTS OpENer_ADD_CIP_OBJECTS_LIST)
        add_definitions(-D${CIP_OBJECT})
    endforeach ()
endif ()

set( OpENer_ADD_CIP_OBJECTS "" CACHE INTERNAL STRING )
set( OpENer_ADD_CIP_OBJECTS_INCLUDES "" CACHE INTERNAL STRING )

#######################################
# Add custom CIP objects              #
#######################################
set( OpENer_CIP_OBJECTS_DIR ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/cip_objects )
include(${OpENer_BUILDSUPPORT_DIR}/OpENer_CIP_Object_generator.cmake)

# ######################################
# Add subdirectories                  #
# ######################################
add_subdirectory( src )
